name: @mod/users-http
asks: Users from an outside ledger (`users-http.verify-url`; `users-http.credential` in the local layer when the ledger asks for one).
`users-http.subject-url`: the lookup by subject; without it, every lookup by subject is unanswerable.
`users-http.identifier-url`: the lookup by identifier; without it, the ledger looks no one up so, and users offers no lookup by identifier.
`users-http.create-url`: the call that makes a subject for an identifier; without it, the ledger makes no subjects.
